abstract: Oversees drill string interfaces, mechanical borehole casing clearances, and sensor array field power supplies
system_message:
You are the Subsurface drilling and access engineer (SDAE). Your business responsibilities include overseeing drill string interfaces, mechanical borehole casing clearances, and sensor array field power supplies, as well as handling drill rig mobilization specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Drill rig mobilization（RIG）
information_points.content:
SDAE-RIG-N76：For Cross-borehole electrical resistivity imaging, the auxiliary mobile hoisting rig provides a winch hoisting capacity of 30 t.
SDAE-RIG-DNG：For Distributed acoustic fiber-optic reflectometry, the auxiliary mobile hoisting rig provides a winch hoisting capacity of 18 t.
SDAE-RIG-9A5：For the Microseismic downhole beamforming array, the auxiliary mobile hoisting rig provides a winch hoisting capacity of 24 t.

information_points.title: Oversees drill string interfaces, mechanical borehole casing clearances, and sensor array field power supplies（BORE）
information_points.content:
SDAE-BORE-H4S：For the Microseismic downhole beamforming array, borehole casing mechanical clearance is verified within Shaft 4 pilot observation boreholes, while the sensor array power demand is 3.2 kW during continuous scanning mode.
SDAE-BORE-N58：For Distributed acoustic fiber-optic reflectometry, borehole casing mechanical clearance is not confirmed within Shaft 4 pilot observation boreholes, and the sensor array power demand is 5.4 kW during continuous scanning mode.
SDAE-BORE-OH5：For Cross-borehole electrical resistivity imaging, borehole casing mechanical clearance is verified within Shaft 4 pilot observation boreholes, and the sensor array power demand is 6.8 kW during continuous scanning mode.
